build_Trainer_optimizer: build a Trainer with a PyTorch model and fairseq args to initialize optimizer and lr scheduler
run_Trainer_train_step: run a training step on a batch of samples with gradient accumulation and clipping
validate_Trainer_model: validate the model on a dataset using a DataLoader with doubled batch size
save_Trainer_checkpoint: save the model state dict optimizer and trainer state to a checkpoint file
load_Trainer_checkpoint: load a saved checkpoint to restore model optimizer lr scheduler and trainer state
